name: Zurich Airport
image: 2013-06-03 07-54-38 Switzerland Kanton Zürich Zürich 59 Exchange Office Kloten Oberfeld.JPG

name: Bus station at Sihlquai
content: The inter-city bus station is two blocks away from the main train station, near the confluence of the Sihl and Limmat and serves mainly international routes by Flixbus and BlaBlaCar. It just consists of a parking lot next to a gas station (not open 24/7)

name: Bahnhofstrasse
content: One of the busiest and best-known shopping streets in the world. Highly refined. Certainly a must-see for every tourist in Zurich!

name: Lindenhof
content: The hill in the heart of the old town. A beautiful view of the city and one time location of a Roman fort.

name: Lake Promenade
content: Especially during summer, the lake is a beautiful place to spend the evening or the weekend. Starting from Bellevue, the boardwalk goes for about three kilometers along the lake towards Tiefenbrunnen. About halfway from Bellevue there is a meadow where you will find thousands of people on a sunny day.

name: Grossmünster
content: Old Romanesque church, symbol of reformed Zurich, where reformer Huldrych Zwingli was appointed the people's priest in 1519. Go up the tower for a great view of Zurich, though the stairs can be quite small and steep.

name: Fraumünster
content: Old Gothic church (former convent) with window paintings made by Marc Chagall. No photos or videos allowed inside.

name: Schanzengraben
content: A small canal that used to be part of the city fortifications between Limmat and Sihl. From the main station, go to Gessnerallee, find the stairways down to the tiny creek, and walk all the way to the lake.

name: Langstrasse
content: Red light district of Zurich, with more drug dealers and police than usual, but interesting because even this most notorious spot in Switzerland is so clean and safe. The area is the most overtly multicultural spot of the town. Ateliers and stylish bars sit side by side the strip clubs.

name: Friedhof Fluntern
content: cemetery with lots of famous people most notably James Joyce who lived in Zurich for quite some time, the writer Elias Canetti and a few nobel prize winners are also buried there

name: Zoo
price: Fr. 26 for adults (Fr. 19 for those under 25)
content: With the new Masoala Rainforest Hall, the Zoo is really worth a visit!

name: China Garden
content: This small but beautiful Chinese garden was offered to the city of Zurich by the Chinese city of Kunming as symbol of gratitude after Zurich helped Kunming with technical knowledge. It can be very well combined with a stroll along the lake or a visit to the Pavillon Le Corbusier.

name: Niederdorf
content: The old town offers beautiful alleys, restaurants and shopping mainly aimed at younger consumers. In the evenings, people visit the Niederdorf's many bars.

name: Zurich West
content: This modern quarter used to be an industrial one, but modern urban developments made it into a centre of vibrant night life.

name: Landesmuseum
hours: Tue-Sun 10:00–17:00 and most public holidays including Mon, Thu until 19ː00
content: This is the place to go if you want to learn more about the history of Switzerland. There are permanent exhibitions on history, archaeology and art. Changing temporary exhibitions usually revolve around Swiss topics.

name: Kunsthaus
price: Fr. 16/11 for the permanent collection. Free on Wednesdays
content: Zurich's most famous art museum. The collection includes works from many Swiss artists, such as the sculptures of Alberto Giacometti or the paintings of Ferdinand Hodler. There are also major works from international artists on display. The museum is building a new extension, scheduled to open in 2020 and thus parts of the museum might be closed at any given time.

name: Johann Jacobs Museum
content: A museum that describes the complex history of global trade routes and goods and the culture around them.

name: Pavillon Le Corbusier
content: This is the last building designed by the Swiss architect le Corbusier. The Pavillon was built after his death as a museum dedicated to his work. Access to the building has long been difficult and expensive, also due to a legal fight between the former patron and initiator of the building and the city of Zurich. Now it is however managed by the city and open to the public. The highlight of the museum is of course the building itself, but there are also yearly changing exhibitions on architecture.

name: Rietberg Museum
directions: Tram 7 for Wollishofen, alight at ‘Museum Rietberg’ stop; five-minute walk to museum S-Bahn to Enge station; ten-minute walk to museum Bus 72 for Morgental, alight at ‘Hügelstrasse’ stop; six-minute walk to museum
content: This is one of the largest art museums in Switzerland, administered by the City of Zurich. Its focus lies on the traditional and contemporary arts and cultures of Asia, Africa, the Americas, and Oceania. The complex consists of three nineteenth-century villas and a coach house, as well as a twenty-first century underground extension crowned by the Emerald, a glass pavilion that opened in 2007, designed by architects Alfred Grazioli and Adolf Krischanitz.

name: Zoological Museum
content: Showcases the zoological collection of the university of Zurich. The first floor has local fauna whereas the lower floor has animals from all over the world.

name: FIFA World Football Museum
content: Explores the world of football and the FIFA.

name: Villa Patumbah
directions: T2 to Höschgasse, then a 650m walk
content: Stunning 19th century villa, which houses an architectural history museum (Heimatschutzzentrum).

name: Polybahn
hours: Operates Mon-Fri 06:45–19:15, Sat 07:30–14:00, closed on Sun and public holidays
price: Fr. 1.20, free with Zürich Card or a valid ZVV ticket for Zone 110
content: A 19th-century funicular, up the steep hill for a fine view. Starts at tram station Central and goes up to the ETH. Nice terrace up there. During the week, the student cafeteria below the terrace is also open to the public.

name: Oberer/Unterer Letten
content: If you go to Zurich during summer take your swimwear with you. The clean river at both the public river baths "Oberer Letten" (mainly youngsters) and "Unterer Letten" (also families) is used by the locals to cool down after hot days. Jump in upstream and the river will carry you down. Right in the middle of the town there is also a wooden floating bath for women only Frauenbad Stadthausquai at the start of the Limmat. Showers and free lockers are provided but you must bring your own lock.

name: trip on the Zürichsee
content: With one of the two old steam ships. There are a few different routes you can choose from, which will vary mainly in the distance. Journeys usually start from Bürkliplatz. Steam ships operate between April and mid-October.
image: Küsnacht - Pfannenstiel - ZSG Säntis & Panta Rhei - Zürichsee in Zürich - Wollishofen 2015-05-06 13-48-07.JPG

name: Limmat river cruise
price: Fr. 4.30, free with Zürich Card or a valid ZVV ticket for Zone 110
content: Offers views of the old town and Lake Zurich. Operates between April and October.

name: Uetliberg
price: Free with Zürich Card or a valid ZVV ticket for the Zones 110, 154, and 155 (costs 4 zones). CHF 2.50 to go up the observation tower
content: A hill overlooking Zurich. You can hike up, or take a train from the "SZU" part of the main station on the S10, which takes about 20 minutes from Zurich HB. Enjoy the 360-degree view from a tall viewing tower (not for vertigo sufferers!) This is also the Start of the Planetenweg (planetary walk), a 12-km (8-mile) walk along the ridge with models of the planets along the way. These are scaled down in true proportion to the solar system. To look at Zurich from the other hills, go to the Irchel (Tram station Milchbuck) or Käferberg (Bucheggplatz, walk up the hill and keep right of the forest).

name: Street Parade
content: The biggest open air techno rave in Europe. It happens one day each year on the second Saturday of August, during which trucks which function as mobile soundsystems ("Love mobiles") start driving along the lake side, starting from the east at Utoquai and ending at the west at Hafen Enge. Every year this event attracts nearly a million visitors who dance in the streets to the music which you can hear from anywhere in the city. After the Street Parade the party doesn't stop, there are open air parties along the route until midnight and club parties at various locations in town until late the next day, to keep the party going. Don't be surprised if the city's cleanliness isn't up to its usual standard the next day. Check out Lethargy festival that happens during the same weekend if you're into less commercial electronic music.

name: Swiss national day
content: 1st of August — Celebrations are carried out in many cities in the evenings and fireworks are launched at night. Watch them over the lake, or if you're experienced with safely launching fireworks yourself, you can buy them in the days leading up to the national holiday and have fun. The display over the Rheinfall, one hour away by S-Bahn, is also extremely popular.

name: Sechseläuten (Sächsilüüte)
content: On the third Monday of April, the guilds of Zurich celebrate their traditional spring festival with the burning of the snow man (Böögg). A procession of several hundreds of people with historical guild costumes and horses takes place in the centre of the town.

name: Caliente Festival
content: The largest Latin festival in Europe. Held every year in early July. Try all types of Latin American food and listen to samba, merengue & co. Huge crowds.

name: Züri Fäscht
content: A weekend festival celebrating Zurich, which occurs every 3 years (last held 7-9 July 2023). It is visited by around 2 million people. In 2023, the committee that had so far organized the Züri Fäscht cancelled their involvement with the event and the partnership with the city. Whether another organization will take over for 2026 is, as of August 2024, unknown.

name: Zürcher Theater Spektakel
directions: Buses No. 161, 165, and Theater-Spektakel-Bus: stop Landiwiese
hours: Last two weeks of Aug, from 17:00
content: A festival for the performing arts. Held along the lake on the Landiwiese near Rote Fabrik and features a number of free performances. Usually in August.

name: Opernhaus
directions: Tram stop Opernhaus, or take the S-train to Stadelhofen
content: The Zurich Opera shows frequently changing productions of world famous operas with top artists. As with the Schauspielhaus, students get a big last-minute discount. The best seats costs Fr. 45 for students.

name: Rote Fabrik
content: An old silk factory converted to a centre of youth culture and art in the 1980s. The Red Factory became one of the most exciting parts of cultural life. An artists' coop, a couple of kilometers south, form along the west bank of Lake Zurich. They have a variety of events, including music, film, and theater, including a restaurant.

name: Schauspielhaus
content: Zurich's Schauspielhaus is one of the most important theatres in the German speaking part of Europe. The Schauspielhaus has several locations, the most important one being the Pfauen. Students can get really cheap last minute tickets (10 minutes before the show) if they show their student ID. The best seats, if available, cost Fr. 20 that way.

name: Theater am Neumarkt
content: Closer to downtown.

name: Tonhalle Maag
directions: S-Bahn station Bahnhof Hardbrücke and tram/bus stops Bahnhof Hardbrücke and Schiffbau
content: During the renovation of the Tonhalle concert house the internationally renowned classical orchestra, the Tonhalle Orchester Zürich, plays at the intermediately built Tonhalle Maag concert hall. From season 2019/20, Paavo Järvi leads the orchestra.

name: Cinema Arthouse Le Paris
directions: Tram stop Stadelhofen, or take the S-train to Stadelhofen
content: Frequently changing arthouse movies; students get a discount.

name: Bahnhofstrasse
content: Runs from the Zürich Train Main station "Hauptbahnhof" right down to the lake. Bahnhofsstrasse is famous for being one of the most exclusive and expensive shopping streets in the world. Here you can get anything from diamond rings to chocolate to fur coats. Globus and Jelmoli are two fiercely competitive department stores, both of which carry items from many high-end brands.

name: Niederdorf
content: The Old Part of Zurich which expands from "Bellevue" by the Lake right to "Central" which is just over the river from the train station. The Niederdorf is more for young people. Aside from a lot of fast food places you will find a lot of trendy clothes stores here.

name: Löwenstrasse
content: Runs west of Bahnhofstrasse from the main train station, has shops selling everyday items and a large branch of Migros, a department store chain.

name: Teuscher
content: — An upscale confiserie that specializes in truffles. There are three stores in Zürich.

name: St. Jakobs Confiserie
content: Badenerstrasse 41. The background organisation, Behindertenwerk St. Jacob, aims at providing jobs for disabled people.

name: Schweizer Heimatwerk
content: Also branches at the Bahnhofstrasse 2 and the airport. Quality Swiss handicrafts and other Swiss-made products presented in a gallery-like setting. You won't find many cuckoo clocks and the like here (cuckoo clocks are not really Swiss, they are from the Black Forest (Schwarzwald) in Germany!), the emphasis is on real traditional crafts and the work of modern craftspeople. You will find things like sleek modern hand-blown glassware and beautiful hand-carved wooden items from the Appenzell region. A worthwhile visit even if you just browse.

name: Flohmarkt Bürkliplatz (Fleamarket)
directions: in the Bellevue area near the Stadelhofen station
content: Fairly relaxed yet large flea market with many interesting stalls.

name: Flohmarkt Kanzlei (Fleamarket)
content: A big flea market that hosts up to 400 stalls on busy days.

name: Orell Füssli
directions: Tram 6, 7, 11, 13, 17 to "Rennweg"; a few hundred meters from Zürich Hauptbahnhof
content: Largest bookshop in Zürich, including a large "English Bookshop" section on the third floor.

name: Sihlcity
content: A good old fashioned shopping mall, which is a 5-minute S-Bahn ride away from the main station. It comprises some 100,000 m² of rental space with a range of facilities, such as restaurants, a shopping center, a multiplex cinema, entertainment, health and fitness/wellness area, nightclub, a Four Points hotel and a chapel.

name: Rheinfelder Bierhalle
directions: at the beginning of the Niederdorf, near Central
content: In this huge and boisterous restaurant you get good value food and rich portions (only try the Jumbo Jumbo Cordon-Bleu when really hungry). Cheap beer. Service can range from very good to poor depending who is working that day.

name: Pizzeria Molino
content: Pizzas and pastas in a relaxed setting. Check website for more locations.

name: Baba's take-away (Restaurant Pumpstation)
content: Part of the Restaurant Pumpstation is located direct at the lake promenade (south of Banhof Stadelhofen). From April–October, serves fresh grilled sausages, ribs, and chicken for about Fr. 6-10.
A nice Turkish place with remarkably good kebab, friendly service, and possibility to seat conveniently inside.

name: Sternen Grill
content: Zurich's most famous sausage stand near Bellevue tram stop. Red or white sausages for around Fr. 6 (Aug 2015), a piece of bread and (hot!) mustard is included.

name: Gambrinus
content: A typical Swiss restaurant with good food and cold beer. It is located in the Red Light District (Langstrasse) of Zurich and is not the ideal place to bring children or acquaintances. Gambrinus looks like a pub more than anything else, but the staff are friendly and speak English. Try the Zürigschnätzlets mit Rösti or the fondue (one of the best in town).

name: Ah-Hua
content: Offers delicious Thai dishes to budget prices. Great pit-stop in a Langstrasse pub crawl.

name: Bank
content: Restaurant, café, bar and bakery in old bank. Mostly organic and Mediterranean food.

name: Millennium Restaurant
directions: Limmatstrasse at Langstrasse, right across the X-tra bar
content: Offers great pizzas, large hamburgers, spicy kebabs and other Italian and Turkish dishes at reasonable prices. Staff is very friendly and service is great. Perfect for lunch or a late-night snack.

name: Rosalys
content: Typical Swiss food including Älplermacrone (pasta with apple purée). Excellent cocktail bar, too.

name: Swiss Chuchi
content: A kitchy place serving up classic Swiss fare, mainly for tourists. Serves fondue year round.

name: Zeughauskeller
content: Offers hearty sausages, stews, rösti potato, etc., in a Brauhaus-like setting. Touristy, but good and large portions. Housed in a historical building, built in 1487.

name: Zum Kropf
directions: just down the street from the Zeughauskeller
content: Offers beer hall fare such as sausages and pork shanks in a somewhat refined setting. The restaurant features a beautiful painted ceiling.

name: Hiltl
content: The oldest vegetarian restaurant in Europe (from 1890).

name: Tibits
content: The fast-food outlet of Hiltl, Europe's oldest vegetarian restaurant. Offers a nice self-service buffet of fresh veggies and fruit and a surprising variety. Try the freshly squeezed juices.

name: Restaurant Eisenhof
content: Has the warm feel of an old pub. The house specialty is horse steak, served on a hot stone with fries.

name: Blinde Kuh
content: Restaurant in complete darkness, served by blind people. An amazing experience.

name: eCHo Restaurant
directions: 5 walking minutes from Zurich HB (Main Train Station)
content: Traditional Swiss cuisine. Everything is prepared according to original recipes, and all products originate from the region.

name: Commercio
content: Excellent pasta and a busy atmosphere.

name: Commi-Halle
content: Italian food served late.

name: Globus Bellevue
content: This relatively new branch of the Globus department store in the Bellevue near the Stadelhofen station is totally dedicated to food. There is a large eatery on the ground floor that serves various fusion-type foods (decent noodle bowl) and a passable sushi bar. The ground floor has a gourmet food market, and upstairs there are kitchen wares.

name: Sprüngli Paradeplatz
content: The flagship store of the Sprüngli confectionery store chain has a beautiful turn-of-the-century style dining room upstairs that is extremely popular for breakfast, lunch and afternoon tea. Choose from the menu or from the gorgeous display case filled with beautiful cakes, tarts, open-face and regular sandwiches. Try the muesli! Great people watching too, since this is the place for an after-shopping snack for the rich ladies of Zurich.

name: Masala
content: Tasty Indian cuisine.

name: Outback Lodge
content: Unrelated to the U.S. Outback Steakhouse chain. Enjoy Aussie tucker like ostrich, kangaroo, and crocodile, as well as more conventional fare. Popular with locals as well as expats. Has a hopping bar scene (see Drink section). There's also a branch in Winterthur.

name: Iroquois
content: Tex-Mex food in the trendiest part of town, with the best margaritas in Zurich.

name: Tiffin's
content: Great place for Asian food. Crowded.

name: Lily's
content: Great Thai and other Asian food. The curries are particularly good and come in huge portions. Come before 19:00 or after 21:00 if you don't want to wait.

name: Manzoni Bar
content: Authentic Italian coffee and aperitif bar that offers clients over 20 different coffee specialties and a vast take away menu. The concept was created by the Manz brothers together with Francesco Illy, the most famous coffee brand in Italy.

name: Nooba
content: Pan-Asian noodle bar, a short walk up the hill from Stadelhofen station. Stylish setting, attentive and multilingual service and a broad selection of freshly prepared noodle, rice and curry dishes.

name: Nooch
content: Yet another Pan-Asian noodle, rice and curry joint. Also has a sushi bar.

name: Ristorante Toscano
content: A very good Italian restaurant in the old part of the city (Niederdorf). You should try the Spaghetti al Bacio!

name: Bebek
content: Breakfast until 16:00. Meze dishes and bar in the evening.

name: White Elephant
directions: 5 walking minutes from Zurich HB (Main Train Station)
content: Original Thai Food. Since 1991 it offers an authentic cuisine with the full scope of original spices.

name: Mesa Restaurant
content: Traditional kitchen with Catalan influences as one of the best restaurants in Zurich

name: Kronenhalle
content: The city's most famous restaurant where all the glitterati go to see and be seen. Good Swiss food and heavenly chocolate mousse are one reason to go, the opportunity to dine among original artwork by famous Swiss and European artists (who paid in paintings instead of money) the other.

name: Widder Hotel
content: High-class food in a cool setting. The hotel has a trendy bar, great piano music, cool red leather decor, and halogen lighting.

name: Zunfthaus Zur Waag
content: Very authentic Swiss high-end restaurant. To ensure your meal does not get cold, they split your order into 2 plates and bring you one at a time.

name: Le Dezaley
directions: Near the Grossmünster Cathedral in a street connecting Limmatquai and the Niederdorf
content: Traditional French-Swiss food from the French-speaking Kanton Waadt (Vaud). One of many fondue restaurants in Zurich.

name: Blaue Ente
directions: at the far end of tram 2 and 4 near Bahnhof Tiefenbrunnen
content: Romantic cuisine in a beautiful building.

name: Coco Grill & Bar
content: Grill restaurant that offers set menus for lunch and a menu surprise for dinner (either fish or meat). Also has a good wine selection and very nice in the summer due to a small garden

name: Da Angela
content: Authentic Italian food.

name: Bar & Lounge 42
directions: 5 walking minutes from Zurich HB (Main Train Station)
content: New York in the middle of Zurich. Exclusive whiskey, unique cocktails, premium liquors, snacks, a homemade gin and an elegant smoker's lounge with a broad selection of cigars.

name: Bierhalle Wolf
directions: At the northern end of the old town, facing the river
content: A lively beer hall often with live music. In addition to the beer selection, they serve great local food.

name: Edi's Weinstube
content: nice wine bar in Niederdorf where you can get the cheapest okay wine in Zurich

name: Federal
content: A big brasserie-like bar inside the Main Station with a choice of 100 Swiss beers.

name: Nachtflug
content: Stylish, coffee and some snacks during the day, large choice of drinks at night.

name: James Joyce bar
content: Where the writer used to drink. Now mostly frequented by bankers.

name: Oliver Twist
content: An Irish/British pub with a good atmosphere, and many English-speaking foreigners. Has English ales on draught.

name: Öpfelchammer
content: Not a real pub or café, they only serve wine or water. But if you succeed in climbing over the roof beams, you get a free glass of wine to drink hanging upside down and you can mark your name into the wood afterwards.

name: Widder Garage
content: By far the best stocked whiskey bar in town, with a separate whiskey menu containing 250 single malts. In the famous hotel of the same name.

name: Corazón
content: A Spanish-themed bar with a good selection of wines and excellent service.

name: Bohemia
directions: at Kreuzplatz, just up from Stadelhofen
content: Trendy place popular for its coffee during the day and an even better nightlife. Usually a popular place for college students.

name: Barfussbar
directions: a 3 minutes walk from Bürkliplatz along the Limmat
content: During the day this is a public bath for women only. But at night (after 20:00) men are also allowed. It is a beautiful place to spend a warm summer night with a great view of Zurich.

name: Rimini
hours: Sun-Fri 19:30–00:00, Sat 17:00–00:00, only in summer and only when it's not raining
content: Another open air bar. This one is at the men's public baths. Really cool atmosphere because of the nice colored lights and the straw mats and pillows.

name: El Lokal
content: Bar, restaurant, and intimate gig venue attracting alternative crowd, "soccer vs elvis vs che guevara" themed.

name: Shamrock Irish Pub
content: Irish pub with regular events & good crowd (food served).

name: Xenix
content: Small art house cinema with a busy beer garden in summer. There's a mixture of students, bohemians, and bicycle messengers posing with their fixies.

name: Total Bar
directions: a block east of the Langstrasse
content: Tiny bar serving a range of Zurich's microbrews. There's always good music.

name: Kasheme
content: This bar is all about good music. It features sometimes world famous DJs doing small mostly vinyl only sessions of funk, soul, disco and of course electronic music.

name: Kanonaegass Bar
content: Nice bar off Langstrasse with good drinks and good music. Bar is owned by 1990s electronic-music/trip-hop pioneer Richard Dorfmeister from Kruder & Dorfmeister.

name: Mars Bar
content: Bar frequented mostly by the leftist youth of Zurich.

name: Acid
content: Hip café and bar.

name: Gotthard Bar
content: This dive bar exists since forever. It's almost always packed, there's live music sometimes. Very mixed crowd but very likeable place.

name: 4. Akt
content: Teens and tweens love this place.

name: Vineria Centrale
content: A cool low key Italian wine bar. Go there for aperitivo and good times.

name: Frau Gerolds Garten
content: huge open air bar with urban gardening and little shops inside. great during summer but also offers a couple tables inside during winter

name: Aya Bar
content: A roof lounge on top the Cinemax complex. Older crowd, very expensive, but stylish.

name: Moods
content: Jazz club in the Schiffbau complex, concerts on Saturdays.

name: X-Tra
content: Big club with events and concerts, the famously have a weekly goth (dark scene) party. Can be trashy depending on the party, check beforehand

name: Hive Club
content: Many rooms to wander through and listen to DJs from Switzerland and abroad. Sometimes offers nonstop parties during the weekends. Focus on Techno and House.

name: Helsinki
content: Small bar and club with nice atmosphere, especially in summer when the outdoor area is open. Live concerts most nights and safe haven for independent artists from all over Switzerland.

name: Gonzo
content: A basement club that generally plays no electronic music. Can be lots of fun but the queues are long and the door can be strict. Great on Wednesday (Hip-Hop) and Thursdays (students).

name: Klaus
content: Member only club that is mostly frequented by the local "scene". Features mostly local DJs but is the new place to be. Befriend a local to get in.

name: Kauz
content: Underground club with great drinks and cocktail selection. house techno and other electronic music

name: Exil
content: small club and concert venue in Kreis 5. Look up what's happening beforehand. Music can range from trap/hiphop to indie rock

name: Friedas Büxe
content: small underground club with techno and house music, beloved by the local scene

name: Rathauscafé
content: Coffee and a croissant in the morning, moving over to sparkling wine in the afternoon and early evening. Nice terrace in the summer. Mixed crowd, friendly service.

name: Cranberry
content: Very crowded on Fridays and Saturdays 20:00–00:00, before the boys head to the clubs.

name: Barfüsser
content: Once Europe's oldest gay bar, it has now been converted into a fancy and large lounge and sushi place. Has a relaxed atmosphere and mixed crowd.

name: Heldenbar
content: Heldenbar is the weekly get together of the local LGBTQI scene.

name: Couchsurfing
content: Has a lot of members in Zurich. Public transport is very fast and good, so also consider staying in surrounding areas instead of in the city centre. Remember that couchsurfing is about the community and not only a free place to crash.

name: Youth hostel
price: From Fr. 42 for a dormitory bed with breakfast; Fr. 104 for a single room with shower
content: A little way out of the centre, but the city is easily reached by public transport (take the S-Bahn to Wollishofen and walk over the hill). A clean and sleek facility, if a little quiet.

name: Hotel Marta
content: A "clean and friendly" place which doubles as a hostel and a one-star hotel. They also have weekly and monthly rates for rooms, and a couple of studio apartments.

name: Otter
content: A good hotel for the price. The rooms have been decorated with the kind of care that one normally expects in a much more expensive hotel, each with its own theme. You can choose from the jungle room with its hammock, or the pink Carmen, or go for the top floor apartment. Each floor's three rooms share a bath, shower and toilet (WC), with the exception of the apartment which has its own shower. Fr. 115 for a single room, Fr. 150 for a double, and Fr. 200 for 2-person apartment (Fr. 240 for 4-person apartment).

name: Hotel Splendid
content: This hotel is relatively cheap. The rooms are clean but spare. Private showers and bathrooms are not available, you share with your floor. What is really great is the location, right close to the Gemüsebrücke and the city centre. Fr. 62-85 for a single, from Fr. 160 for a 4-person room, plus Fr. 2.50 City-Taxe per person.

name: Etap Hotel
price: 90 Fr (low season) to Fr. 115 (high season) for a single room, and from Fr. 100 for double/triple occupancy. For Zurich, this is cheap
content: This hotel is in a great place if you want to party, next to some great bars and restaurants. The rooms are clean and comfortable. It's also near a tram station, which takes 10 minutes to get to the main train station.

name: Hotel Schäfli
content: The location is the draw in this somewhat run-down hotel. Situated in the old town near the station and by the charming Niederdorfstrasse, where there are tons of bars and restaurants. The shower has a timer. Be sure to get all the coins for the shower you need by Saturday, as the reception desk closes on Sundays. Fr. 102 for a double room.

name: Hotel Neufeld
content: The comfortable, modern 3-star owner-run hotel is located just a few minutes away from the city centre. All 40 new renovated rooms are comfortable and modern furnished. Perfect for businespeople and tourists. The rates start from Fr. 110 for a single and Fr. 155 for a double room, including tax breakfast and free wifi.

name: Hotel St. Georges
content: Traditional and charming owner run hotel in the city centre, 10 minutes walking distance to the train station. Convenient for businespeople as well as tourists and backpackers. The rates start from Fr. 99 for a single and Fr. 228 for a double room, including tax, breakfast and free Wifi.

name: Hotel Adler
content: Clean rooms and breakfast is included in the price. They have a terrific restaurant attached and associated with the hotel that has delicious fondue. The hotel is in a great area for foot exploration. With many bars, restaurants, and cafes all within a few minutes. They have a single computer on the second floor with free internet access.

name: Ambassador à l'Opéra
content: Four-star boutique hotel situated in the town centre, opposite the Opera House and only 10 min away from the main station Hauptbahnhof and 30 minutes from the Zurich airport. Renovated and exquisitely decorated. Single room from Fr. 220, two-person room from Fr. 390 in the low season.

name: Helmhaus
content: Three tram stops with tram number 4 from the main station. Located directly next to the Limmat in the old town of Zurich. Very traditional four star hotel with first-class service, style and modern comfort. Single room from Fr. 230, double room from Fr. 300.

name: Sorell Hotel Rex
price: Single room from Fr. 140, twin room from Fr. 190
content: Three-star hotel, 5 minutes by tram number 7 from the Hauptbahnhof. All rooms are non-smoking.

name: Wellenberg
content: The four-star Art Deco Hotel Wellenberg with its idyllic inner court terrace is in the car-free old town of Zurich, 10 walking minutes from the Hauptbahnhof. The rooms are modern and elegant. One-person room from Fr. 290, two-person room from Fr. 370.

name: Palais Kraft
content: Three luxury rooms in Zurich's most prestigious residential building. Located 2km from the centre, above the university district at Toblerplatz (Trams 5 and 6, direction Zoo), in the heart of Zurich's prime residential area. The rooms come with a large well-stocked fridge, kitchenette, 32" or bigger flat screen TV, wireless internet access, and open to the terrace of the Palais Kraft. Beginning at Fr. 385 per room/night, including continental breakfast, soft drinks, snacks, internet, local calls, and all taxes. Fr. 330 double-bed guest room with bath and kitchenette.

name: Designer Hotel Greulich
content: Located in the heart of Zurich's vibrant Aussersihl district, the stunning Hotel Greulich is a haven of style and comfort with a renowned gourmet restaurant. Online booking.

name: Hotel St. Gotthard Zürich
content: Business hotel. A five-floor building, with 143 spacious rooms, 11 of which aresSuites, comfortable lobby and three restaurants, the Hotel Gotthard meets all the expectations of the demanding traveller. The Hotel Gotthard lies center of the city, located on the Bahnhofstrasse, within 10 minutes walk from sightseeing, the business district and Lake Zurich.

name: Crowne Plaza Zürich
price: €150-300 per night depending on the room type and the season
content: Clean rooms and breakfast included in most of the rates. It has a fitness centre, a bar and a restaurant. It is about 200 m away from Albisreiden Tram station (tram number 3).

name: Dorint Airport-Hotel Zürich
content: The hotel (opened in 2014) is located near the airport and offers 235 rooms.

name: Hotel Widder
price: From Fr. 600 single room to Fr. 1500 for 1-bedroom suite
content: Known for excellent service and location in the old town, 1-2 min from Bahnhofstrasse.

name: Movenpick Zurich Airport Hotel
content: Glattbrugg. 5-star hotel minutes from Zurich Airport offering accommodation, 3 restaurants, meeting & conference facilities and a gym.

name: Hotel zum Storchen
content: On the river Limmat with an exclusive restaurant.

name: Baur au lac
content: Located at the lake, excellent restaurant, popular with actors, celebrities, and politicians.

name: Savoy Baur en Ville
content: Rooms are clean and modern but small.

name: Park Hyatt Zurich
content: expensive but has a very nice room and spa there is a casino too.

name: Dolder Grand
content: Kurhausstrasse 65, flagship hotel of Zurich with amazing view and excellent spa.

name: ALDEN Hotel Splügenschloss
content: A small and intimate five-star boutique hotel in Zürich, located on a quiet side street, near the lakeshore and Bahnhofstrasse. The hotel comprises of two restored landmark buildings and has a modern interior.

name: Zurich Marriott Hotel
directions: 5 walking minutes from Zurich HB (Main Train Station)
content: International business hotel with spacious guest rooms, popular restaurants, meeting facilities and a fitness center.

name: Fischer's Fritz Camping
content: This camp site is the closest to the city. Many guests were not too happy with the facilities and the friendliness of the owners.

name: CHECK-IN all-ways
content: Drops at hotels around Zurich and faraway towns upon request. Cheaper per person fares if traveling with at least 2 passengers. Bus leaves the airport every 30 minutes.

name: Arlberg Express
content: Serves the Arlberg ski resort.

name: Flugbus
content: Transfer between Zurich Airport and Chur or Lucerne.

name: Deck E passenger observation deck
directions: take the westernmost elevator to the 2nd floor
content: If your flight departs from Terminal E don't miss out on this stunning observation deck with an almost 360°-view of the whole airport. Free binoculars are installed at different locations of the observation deck to help you spot aircraft further away. There is also a play area for children.
image: Flughafen Zürich Besucherterrasse Dock E im Jahr 2020.jpg

name: Swiss Arrival Lounge
content: After a long flight, you can use the lounge to freshen up with showers and breakfast buffet.

name: Swiss Lounge A
content: Contains the first class, and business class & senator lounge. Includes a special section called the Alpine Lounge with designs resembling a rustic Alpine lodge with wooden materials and a fitting view of the Alps.

name: Swiss Lounge D
content: Located in the non-Schengen boarding area, contains the business class, and the senator lounge.

name: Swiss Lounge E
content: Contains the first class, senator, and business class lounge. The first class lounge features two first-come first-served hotel rooms, wine cellar and ala carte meals. Its whisky club with a collection of 200 varieties is also accessible for both First and Senator lounge visitors.

name: Aspire Lounges
directions: Terminal 2 Level 3, access between gates E47 and E53

name: Alpenblick Bar
content: Bar with splendid views of the tarmac, also of the main terminal building, and the Alps on a lucky sunny day. Sandwiches and beverages, both soft and alcoholic.

name: Bakeside
content: Sandwiches, vegan snacks, juices, and coffee.

name: Pret A Manger
content: Wrapped premium sandwiches and salads, yoghurt parfait and cut fruits.

name: Coop Pronto
content: For a quick shopping run or even something to eat, there is an express supermarket.

name: Migros
content: A large Swiss franchise containing products of a typical supermarket, including Swiss chocolates and cheese, in some ways cheaper than the gourmet confectionaries.

name: Transit Hotel at Zurich Airport
price: From Fr. 49 (day, up to 3 hours) to Fr. 99 (overnight) for a single room. Reclining chair: Fr. 25 (up to 3 hours) to Fr. 45 (overnight). Shower only Fr. 15.
content: If you have plenty of time to kill until your flight, this hotel could be an option.

name: Hyatt Regency Zurich Airport
content: A posh hotel with rooms in contemporary design, some with splendid views of the greenery behind the airport building.

name: Radisson Blu
content: A fine landside hotel for an overnight stay or meetings adjacent to the airport. Featuring two restaurants and a wine bar for leisure.

name: ibis budget Zurich Airport
content: Perhaps the cheapest hotel close to the airport. Budget hotel with modern design and simple furniture. Small double and triple rooms.

name: Leonardo Hotel Zurich Airport
content: A small but modern hotel featuring large rooms up to 4 people, a buffet breakfast, restaurant, and bar.

name: Mövenpick Hotel Zurich Airport
content: 5-star hotel minutes from Zurich Airport offering accommodation, 3 restaurants, meeting & conference facilities and a gym.

name: Dorint Airport-Hotel Zürich
content: The hotel (opened in 2014) is near the airport and offers 235 rooms.

name: Flughafen Zürich
content: Zürichs internationaler Flughafen "Zürich-Kloten" liegt etwa 15 Zugminuten vom Stadtzentrum entfernt. Der Bahnhof befindet sich gleich im Flughafengebäude. Nationale Fluglinie und Platzhirsch ist die Swiss. Aber auch Lufthansa bietet Flüge von Deutschland an. Der Flug von Frankfurt am Main nach Zürich dauert zwischen 30 bis 40 Minuten.

name: Hauptbahnhof Zürich
content: Der Hauptbahnhof Zürich ist als großer Knotenbahnhof an das internationale Zugnetz angeschlossen. Aus dem deutschsprachigen Raum bestehen tagsüber regelmäßige Direktverbindungen ab Frankfurt am Main via Basel (mit ICE), ab München (mit EuroCity-Express) sowie Wien via Innsbruck (mit railjet). Zudem verkehrt der TGV Lyria mehrmals täglich nach Paris sowie EC der SBB nach Mailand.

name: Wasserkirche
content: Eine Kirche am rechten Ufer der Limmat in der Zürcher Altstadt. Mutmaßliche Hinrichtungsstätte der Zürcher Stadtheiligen Felix und Regula. Sehenswert auch die archäologischen Funde in der Krypta. Draussen vor dem Chor zudem ein Zwngli-Denkmal aus dem späten 19. Jahrhundert.

name: Grossmünster
content: Das Grossmünster gehört zusammen mit dem Fraumünster wohl zu den bekanntesten Kirchen Zürichs. Der Bau begann um 870 auf Anweisung von Karl dem Dicken. Die Kirche war Ausgangspunkt und Zentrum der deutschschweizerischen Reformation unter Huldrych Zwingli. Der Blick vom Turm ist den Aufstieg über die 180 Stufen wert.

name: Fraumünster
content: Gestiftet von König Ludwig dem Deutschen, erbaut ab Mitte des 9. Jahrhunderts. Die Kirche ist berühmt für ihre prächtigen Glasfenster von Marc Chagall.

name: St. Peter
content: St. Peter ist die älteste Pfarreikirche Zürichs. Erstmals erwähnt wurde die Kirche 850, erbaut wurde sie aber vermutlich schon zweihundert Jahre vorher. Seit 1360 befindet sich in ihr das Grab von Rudolf Brun, dem ersten Bürgermeister von Zürich. An der Kirchenmauer befindet sich der Grabstein von Johann Caspar Lavater, reformierter Pfarrer, Philosoph und Schriftsteller. Die Kirche verfügt mit einem Durchmesser von 8.7 m über das grösste Turmzifferblatt Europas.

name: Alfred Escher
content: Direkt vor dem Haupteingang des Hauptbahnhofs steht das Denkmal von Alfred Escher als Erinnerung an seine Verdienste für die moderne Schweiz. Der unermüdliche Politiker blieb hauptsächlich als Eisenbahnpionier in Erinnerung. Aber auch in anderen Bereichen war er aktiv. So gründete er unter anderem die Schweizerische Kreditanstalt (heute Credit Suisse), die Schweizerische Rentenanstalt (heute Swiss RE) und die ETH (Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule)

name: Ulrich Zwingli
content: Steht direkt neben der Wasserkirche am Limmatquai. Zwingli reformierte die Kirche um 1525. Er starb 1531 im 2. Kappelerkrieg (Religionskrieg)

name: Hans Waldmann
content: Am der Wasserkirche entgegengesetzten Ende der Münsterbrücke steht das Denkmal von Hans Waldmann (*1435, †6. April 1489), dem ebenso berühmten wie umstrittenen Bürgermeister und Heerführer von Zürich und Held in den Schlachten gegen Karl den Kühnen.

name: Zoologisches Museum der Universität Zürich
content: Das 1833 zusammen mit der Universität eröffnete Zoologische Museum zählt zu den bestbesuchten Museen der Stadt Zürich. Hier sind über 1.500 Tiere ausgestellt. Die Geschichte der Sammlungen des Zoologischen Museums geht bis ins 17. Jahrhundert zurück. Heute umfassen die Sammlungen nahezu eine Million Tiere. Das Zoologische Museum der Universität Zürich trägt mit seinen Ausstellungen zur Information und zur selbständigen Meinungsbildung in der Öffentlichkeit bei.

name: Schweizerisches Landesmuseum
price: Erwachsene CHF 10.-, reduziert CHF 8.-, Kinder bis 16 Jahre Eintritt frei
content: Das Schweizerische Landesmuseum wurde 1898 unter der Leitung von G. Gull erbaut. Im Bau wurden verschiedene Architekturstile aus den diversen Schweizer Regionen integriert. Das Museum beherbergt die grösste kulturgeschichtliche Sammlung der Schweiz und zeigt in den sechs permanenten Ausstellungen Schweizer Geschichte von den Anfängen bis heute. Der 2016 eröffnete Neubau bietet grosse, flexible Ausstellungshallen, eine moderne Bibliothek und ein Auditorium für öffentliche Veranstaltungen.

name: Kunsthaus Zürich
content: Attraktive Ausstellungen und eine Sammlung von Gegenwartskunst zurück bis ins 15. Jahrhundert.

name: Museum Bärengasse
price: Eintrittspreise Museum: Erwachsene CHF 8.-, reduziert CHF 6.-, Kinder bis 16 Jahren Eintritt frei.

name: Zunfthaus zur Meisen
price: Eintrittspreise: CHF 3.-, Kinder bis 16 Eintritt frei
content: Porzellan- und Fayenceausstellung.

name: Tram Museum
price: Eintrittspreise: Erwachsene (ab 18 J.): CHF 12.-, Jugendliche (16-18 J.): CHF 8,-, Kinder (6-16 J.): CHF 6.-, Familien Karte CHF 20.- (Eltern und/ oder Grosselten (max. Erwachsene) + Kinder/Enkelkinder)
content: Das im Jahr 2007 eröffnete Museum im ehemaligen Depot Burgwies zeigt die Geschichte und Fahrzeuge der Strassenbahn in Zürich: Originalfahrzeuge aus den Jahren 1897 bis 1968, Motoren, Uniformen, Billettautomaten, eine grosse Modell-Tramanlage, ein rollendes Baby-Cobra und vieles mehr. Ein Teil der betriebsfähigen Strassenbahnen fahren an gewissen Tagen als Linie 21 durch Zürich. Fahrplan der Linie 21 (pdf). Auch ein Museumsbus ist zeitweise auf der Linie 51 unterwegs.

name: Museum Rietberg
directions: Tram 7 Richtung Wollishofen bis «Museum Rietberg», 5 Minuten Fussweg S-Bahn bis Bahnhof Enge, 10 Minuten Fussweg Bus 72 Richtung Morgental bis Haltestelle «Hügelstrasse», 6 Minuten Fussweg
content: Kunst der Welt in Zürich: Das Museum Rietberg ist ein Museum der Stadt Zürich und zählt zu den grössten Kunstmuseen der Schweiz. Es widmet sich der Kunst der traditionellen, aber auch der zeitgenössischen Kulturen Asiens, Afrikas, Amerikas und Ozeaniens. Der Gebäudekomplex besteht aus drei Villen und der Remise aus dem 19. Jahrhundert sowie dem 2007 eröffneten Erweiterungsbau der Architekten Alfred Grazioli und Adolf Krischanitz.

name: Medizinhistorische Sammlung der Universität
address: Rämistrasse 71, Eingang Künstlergasse 16, Hauptgebäude der Universität, 4. Stock
content: Das 1932 gegründetete Museum zeigt die Entwicklung der Medizin vom Mittelalter bis heute. Etliche anatomische Modelle des 17.-19. Jahrhunderts, sowie eine Rekonstruktion einer alten Apotheke und eines Krankenzimmers.

name: Moulagensammlung des Universitätsspitals
content: Die Sammlung zeigt Wachsnachbildungen von Hauterkrankungen.

name: Kulturama, Museum des Menschen
hours: Di – So 13.00 – 17.00 Uhr, vormittags für Schulen und Gruppen mit Führung nach Vereinbarung.

name: Nordamerika Native Museum (NONAM)
content: Museum zur Kunst und Kultur der nordamerikanischen Indianer und der Inuit.

name: Alter Botanischer Garten
content: Der alte botanische Garten "Zur Katz" zwischen dem Schanzengraben und der Talstrasse wurde durch den neuen Botanischen Garten ersetzt.

name: Flightbase
content: Flugsimulatorcenter in der Stadt Zürich. Es sind Flüge auf dem Boeing 777 oder dem F/A-18 Kampfjetsimulator möglich. Letzterer wird mit Virtual Reality betrieben. Ebenso steht ein Formel 1 Simulator mit Motion zur Verfügung.

name: Zoo
content: Besonderheit: die Masoalahalle, die rund 45 freilaufenden Tierarten und etwa 35'000 Individuen aus Madagaskars Flora und Fauna auf knapp 11'000 m² beherbergt.

name: Art on Ice
content: Eisgala, Anfang Februar.

name: Fasnacht / Züri Carneval
content: Im Februar.

name: Sechseläuten
content: 3. Montag im April.

name: Zürich Marathon
content: Im April.

name: Zürcher Festspiele
content: Mitte Juni bis Mitte Juli.

name: Caliente Festival
content: Lateinamerikanische Musik.

name: VaporSpirit
content: Zentral gelegenes Fachgeschäft in Zürich für natürliche Cannabidiol-Produkte wie Vollspektrum-Öle, Vape-Kartuschen und Kosmetika – alles legal mit weniger als 1 % THC. Ideal für Reisende, die hochwertige Hanfprodukte suchen.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt
content: Jeden Dezember wird in der Halle des Zürcher Hauptbahnhofes ein Weihnachtsmarkt aufgebaut. Besonders sehenswert ist dann auch der mit Swarovskikristallen geschmückte Christbaum. Daneben bestehen an weiteren Orten Weihnachtsmärkte, darunter im Niederdorf und auf dem Sechseläutenplatz beim Bellevue.

name: Migros Restaurants
content: Günstige Menüs und Selbstbedienung. Meistens in der Nähe einer Filiale der Ladenkette Migros zu finden.

name: Coop Restaurants
content: Günstige Menüs und Selbstbedienung. Meistens in der Nähe einer Filiale der Ladenkette Coop zu finden.

name: New Point
content: Zu empfehlen: Pepito (CHF 9,50) - Baguette mit wahlweise Fisch, Putenbrust etc. Einfach in der Nähe von Clubs nach New Point fragen... Die Filialen befinden sich immer dort in der Nähe...

name: Restaurant Zeughauskeller
content: Feine Schweizer Gerichte, in historischer Umgebung.

name: Gaststube Haldenegg
content: Es gibt Fondue aus einer Bio-Käsemischung, Burger, vegetarische Gerichte.

name: Hiltl
content: Zürichs grösstes und ältestes vegetarisches Restaurant, vegetarische Küche seit 1898. Nach dem Umbau bietet das Hiltl nun einerseits ein bedientes Restaurant und anderseits einen Take Away, den man jedoch auch im Hause selbst geniessen kann. Grossartige Auswahl am vegetarischen Buffet, besonders Sonntags ist die indische Küche am Buffet präsent. Abends eine Bar und Club.

name: Josef
content: Gemütliches Ambiente, mit gut kombiniertem und befriedigendem Essen. Bezaubernde Menüs in Form der Nouvelle Cuisine angerichtet. Mittag und Sonntags geschlossen.

name: White Elephant Restaurant
directions: 5 Minuten zu Fuss vom Hauptbahnhof Zürich
hours: Mo-Fr 12-14 Uhr, Mo-So 18-22 Uhr, Fr - Sa 18-23 Uhr
content: Authentisch Thai. Das White Elephant gilt als eines der besten und beliebtesten thailändischen Restaurants in Zürich. Seit 1991 bürgt es für eine authentische Küche.

name: eCHo Restaurant
directions: 5 Minuten zu Fuss vom Hauptbahnhof Zürich
content: Schweizer Küche nach Originalrezept! Das eCHo Restaurant hat sich mit Leib und Seele der Schweizer Küche verschrieben. Die Gerichte werden nach Originalrezepten zubereitet und es werden ausschliesslich regionale Produkte verwendet. Gäste dürfen sich "uf es Schwiizer Erläbnis" freuen.

name: Bar & Lounge 42
directions: 5 Minuten zu Fuss vom Hauptbahnhof Zürich
content: New York mitten in Zürich. Die Bar & Lounge 42 bietet Whiskey Spezialitäten, einzigartige Cocktails, Premium Spirituosen, Snacks, einen hauseigenen Gin und eine elegante Zigarrenlounge.

name: Gertrudhof
price: Cordon bleu ab 21 CHF, Beilagen dazu ab 5,50 CHF
content: Mehr als 15 verschiedene Cordon bleu auf der Speisekarte.

name: Restaurant Kronenhalle
content: Schlichtweg ein Unikum von Zürich. Austaffiert mit einigen grossartigen Bildern von wichtigen Schweizer Malern wie Giacometti oder Hodler und auch von Künstlern mit internationalem Renomee wie Chagall entsteht eine unvergleichliche Atmosphäre. Die Speisen sind von unaufgeregtem Format, es werden Klassiker wie Entrecôte Café de Paris und Pommes frites, Wienerschnitzel oder Mousse au Chocolat serviert.

name: The Restaurant
content: Das The Restaurant des Dolder Grand Hotels bietet junge und innovative Gourmetküche von Chef Fine Dining Heiko Nieder, ausgezeichnet mit 17 Gault-Millau-Punkten und zwei Michelin-Sternen. Über Mittag empfiehlt sich das Amuse-Bouche-Menü, welches einen Querschnitt durch die Menü-Karte bietet. Am Abend werden 4- bis 7-Gang-Menüs serviert, ein spezielles vegetarisches Menü oder ein 12-Gang-Tasting-Menü.

name: TurbinenBräu
content: Verschiedene Biere aus eigener Produktion, Aussensitzplätze, abwechslungsreiche Küche, die Spezialität sind Bierfladen mit Treber, vegetarische und vegane Gerichte.

name: x-tra
content: Cool Monday: jeden Montag; eine wenn nicht "die" grösste Studentenparty in Europa, ab 18 Jahren; am Mittwoch am gleichen Ort More Than Mode 80er, Wave und Gothicparty, ebenfalls mit freiem Eintritt.

name: Plaza
content: Jeden Donnerstag findet das Nachtseminar statt die beliebteste Studentenparty

name: Longstreet Bar
price: Eintritt frei, auch wenn Konzerte stattfinden
content: Bar und Club in einem, den Gang die Treppe rauf ins Obergeschoss. Es lohnt sich, wenn geöffnet.

name: Helsinki
price: Eintritt von gratis bis 20 sFr, je nach Veranstaltung
content: Regelmässig Konzerte

name: Zukunft
content: Guter Club. Bitte nicht zu warm anziehen, es tropft wegen der grossen Hitze und des relativ kleinen Raums zuweilen von der Decke, wenn die Party richtig läuft.

name: Hive
content: Am Wochenende hauptsächlich Electro, Minimal, etc. Recht grosser Club mit 2 Etagen.

name: Kaufleuten
price: Preise variieren stark zwischen 20 und 50 CHF
content: Tanzfläche mit 2. Stockwerken und Balkon.

name: Hostel Krone Zurich Bed and Breakfast
content: Hostel an der Limmat Zurich im Niederdorf. Ein günstiges einfaches bed and breakfast.

name: Youth Hostel, Jugendherberge
content: Moderne Jugendherberge, etwa 15 Minuten vom Zentrum entfernt.

name: Langstars Backpacker-Hostel
content: Liegt direkt an der Langstrasse, die Partymeile der Schweiz - nur 1 km vom Hauptbahnhof mit einer coolen Hostelbar mit vielen Konzerten.

name: Krone Limmatquai
content: Kleines einfaches Hotel im Niederdorf, direkt an der Limmat.

name: Martahaus
content: Ca. 5-10 Gehminuten vom Hauptbahnhof.

name: Formula 1 Zürich Messe/ Airport
content: Liegt in Zürich Nord Nähe Messe Zürich und Hallenstadion.

name: ibis budget Zürich City West
content: In Zürich West,in der Nähe der sogenannten Kulturmeile.

name: Ibis Zürich City-West
content: Gutes Preis-Leistungverhältniss, liegt an der sogenannten Kulturmeile.

name: Novotel Zürich City-West
content: Ist im gleichen Gebäude wie das IBIS. Zimmer sind etwas exlusiver aber auch teurer.

name: Crowne Plaza Hotel
address: Badener Str. 420, nahe dem Letzigrund Fussballstadion
content: Ein kleines (winziges) DZ kostet immerhin auch am Wochenende 310,00 SFR.

name: Dorint Airport-Hotel Zürich
content: Das 2014 eröffnete und nahe dem Airport gelegene Hotel bietet 235 Zimmer.

name: Widder Hotel
content: Das Widder-Hotel ist ein Design-Hotel der Luxusklasse! Optimal gelegen in der Altstadt, nur wenige Meter von der berühmten Bahnhofstrasse entfernt. Jedes Zimmer ist individuell gestaltet und lässt keine Wünsche offen. Nichts für Wellness-Touristen, da diese Infrastruktur fast gänzlich fehlt.

name: Park Hyatt Zürich
content: Im Park Hyatt erwarten Sie geräumige Zimmer. Die Lage ist in einem Geschäftsviertel, sehr zentral nahe von See und Bahnhofstrasse.

name: Hotel Baur au Lac
content: Im "Baur au lac" leben Sie wie in der Belle epoque. Kein Trend-Hotel. Vielleicht eher etwas für ältere Gäste. Ist sicher eines der am schönsten gelegenen Hotels von Zürich - beim See und gleichzeitig am Beginn der Bahnhofstrasse.

name: Hotel Savoy Baur en Ville
price: Ein DZ kostet hier mehr als 650 SFR pro Nacht
content: Das Hotel am Paradeplatz ist das teuerste und luxuriöseste Hotel in Zürich in der Nähe der Bahnhofstrasse. Es ist das traditionsreiche Luxushotel inmitten des Finanz- und Shoppingzentrums Zürichs.

name: Zürich Marriott Hotel
directions: 5 Minuten zu Fuss vom Hauptbahnhof Zürich
content: Das internationale Business Hotel liegt im Herzen der Stadt am Ufer der Limmat und bietet geräumige Gästezimmer, beliebte Restaurants, Meeting- und Veranstaltungsfläche und ein Fitness Center.

name: Universität Zürich
content: Im Hauptgebäude befindet sich ein besonders sehenswerter großer Lichthof.

name: Eidgenössisch Technische Hochschule Zürich ETH
content: Mit der Polybahn ab Central Platz in circa Minuten vom Hauptbahnhof zu erreichen. Die Polyterrasse vor der ETH Zürich ist ein ausgezeichneter Aussichtspunkt mit Blick über die ganze Stadt.

name: Fachhochschule für Wirtschaft und Verwaltung
content: Sehenswerte, moderne Architektur.

name: Pädagogische Hochschule Zürich
content: Die Aus- und Weiterbildungsstätte für Lehrpersonen im Kanton Zürich befindet sich in der Lagerstrasse 2, direkt am Hauptbahnhof.

name: Honorargeneralkonsulat der Republik Österreich
hours: für Parteienverkehr: Mo – Fr 9.00 – 12.00 Uhr, Mo – Do 14.00 – 16.00 Uhr, nur auf Terminvereinbarung

name: Tramhaltestelle Bahnhofquai
content: Tramlinien 4 11 13 14 17

name: Tramhaltestelle Sihlquai
content: Tramlinien 4 13 17

name: Tramhaltestelle Bahnhofstrasse
content: Tramlinien 6 7 11 13 17

name: Tramhaltestelle Bahnhofplatz
content: Tramlinien 3 10 14

name: Tramhaltestelle Sihlpost
content: Tramlinien 3 14
